method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-2.01:-1.93,E:0.88:0.96,S:-0.71:-0.63,N:0.91:0.99)
note: North wall steps (face 0.95 covers 68 %, 0.68 covers 32 % -> 0.95); closet front at x 0.69 in front of the east wall (furniture -> wall 0.92).
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
